name: uiux-builder
description: Web-based WYSIWYG UI/UX builder for designing and managing PC and mobile screens (server + client).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @uiux/server && npm run build -w @uiux/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @uiux/server
